Published getters require Complete, sealed FP/CSV provenance and an independently computed complete result fingerprint. Failed computation retains partial stores and refuses retry.
Real prior archive supplies exact pre-edit bytes. Kernel change only adds required lazy identity-cache binding callback at its native point. No parser change or imported cached-value fallback.

qualifications: The portable verifier attests a fixed embedded reference algorithm/build receipt and current logical inputs/results. It is not observation of the current Rust thread or a running native process.
Actual observed startup FP state is PC53 in capture03; PC24 and PC64 remain explicit laboratory inputs.
Input-binding failure may leave previously interned Bank tokens, but installs no State until complete binding succeeds. No transactional rollback claim.
Nonempty Upgrade/Settlement geometry, shared or externally overwritten Performer abilities and unsupported manager closures refuse explicitly; no fabricated success/default.
Prerequisite source passes have separately audited CV-disjoint typed nonalias writes; their full non-CV work is not completed by this module.
